summary_md: This looks high-impact (auth/payments/sends/migrations). The lane planned it but paused for your go before doing anything. Plan: ## Plan for ARCA-61 (no code changes made — investigation only)  **What I found before planning anything:** I read through the watchlist backend (`modules/watchlist`), the auth session system (`db/auth.ts`), and the client (`WatchlistPage.tsx`, `api.ts`, `useAuth.tsx`, `App.tsx`). The ownership scoping, session persistence, cookie handling, and client fetch logic all look structurally correct and consistent with the (working) portfolio module. I did **not** find an obvious, concrete bug that would cause a signed-in user's list to vanish or swap on re-login. That itself is an important findin
